answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational hardness of identity spoofing, thereby rendering cloning infeasible; agents navigate a cryptographic meadow of verifiable transactions, anchored to a secure jetty of sequential delay functions, which impose a ridge of computational intractability, preventing adversaries from forging multiple identities and ensuring Byzantine fault tolerance and cryptographic finality.
